prompts.title: Collector Specification Sheet
prompts.promptText:
# ROLE

You are an award-winning automotive creative director and editorial designer specializing in luxury automotive brochures, industrial design presentations, and museum-quality collector posters.

Your work combines the visual language of:

• Porsche Design Studio
• Apple Industrial Design
• Dieter Rams
• Braun
• Swiss Graphic Design
• Monocle Magazine
• Porsche Press Kits
• BMW Heritage Catalogs
• Mercedes-Benz Design Books
• Automotive Engineering Specification Sheets

The result must look like an official manufacturer design document—not an AI-generated poster.

--------------------------------------------------

# OBJECTIVE

Design a premium automotive collector specification sheet.

NOT an advertisement.

NOT a movie poster.

NOT a social media graphic.

Instead create an official-looking concept vehicle presentation that could be printed inside a manufacturer's confidential design portfolio.

The design should feel timeless, restrained, luxurious, and extremely expensive.

--------------------------------------------------

# CANVAS

Orientation:
Portrait

Aspect Ratio:
4:5

Resolution:
8K

Print Ready

Ultra Sharp

Museum Quality

Perfect Typography

--------------------------------------------------

# VEHICLE

Car:
[CAR MODEL]

Brand:
[CAR BRAND]

Year:
[YEAR]

Color:
[CAR COLOR]

Body Style:
[BODY STYLE]

Preserve the exact proportions, body lines, wheels, headlights, grille, mirrors, windows, badges, and overall identity of the vehicle.

Ultra photorealistic.

No redesign.

No exaggerated proportions.

--------------------------------------------------

# MAIN IMAGE

Large hero render occupying approximately 55–60% of the page.

Three-quarter front view.

Low camera angle.

85mm lens.

Slight steering angle.

Studio photography.

Perfect reflections.

Luxury automotive lighting.

The vehicle should dominate the composition while maintaining generous negative space.

--------------------------------------------------

# BACKGROUND

Minimal off-white museum paper.

Warm white.

Very subtle texture.

Soft gradient only.

No scenery.

No roads.

No buildings.

No sky.

No environment.

No distracting graphics.

--------------------------------------------------

# LAYOUT

Strict Swiss Grid.

Everything perfectly aligned.

Large margins.

Consistent spacing.

Invisible baseline grid.

Professional editorial hierarchy.

Every section aligned precisely.

Nothing randomly placed.

--------------------------------------------------

# HEADER

Small brand name.

Large model name.

Large year.

Small "Concept" or "Vision" subtitle.

One short design philosophy sentence.

Example:

"The next chapter of electric performance."

--------------------------------------------------

# TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

Create a professional engineering specification table.

Include:

Powertrain

Engine

Horsepower

Torque

Transmission

Drive Type

Battery Capacity

Range

Acceleration

Top Speed

Length

Width

Height

Wheelbase

Weight

Seats

Body Style

Platform

Use thin divider lines.

Perfect alignment.

Minimal typography.

--------------------------------------------------

# ENGINEERING DRAWINGS

Generate clean technical line drawings of the same vehicle.

Include:

Side View

Front View

Rear View

Top View

Dimension arrows.

Measurements.

Fine engineering lines.

Blueprint aesthetic.

Minimal grayscale.

--------------------------------------------------

# DESIGN PHILOSOPHY

Create a short editorial paragraph describing:

• Design language
• Aerodynamics
• Performance philosophy
• Materials
• Driver experience

Professional automotive editorial tone.

Never sound like marketing.

--------------------------------------------------

# PERFORMANCE ICONS

Include minimal monochrome icons representing:

Performance

Precision

Electric

Aerodynamics

Innovation

Driver Focus

Lightweight

--------------------------------------------------

# SPECIMEN SECTION

Bottom-right corner.

Collector edition label.

Example:

Specimen

01 / 100

Limited Concept Series

Small barcode.

Internal reference number.

--------------------------------------------------

# FOOTER

Very small typography.

Examples:

Renault Design Center

Concept Vehicle

Internal Development Program

Confidential Prototype

Design Archive

Engineering Division

--------------------------------------------------

# TYPOGRAPHY

Swiss Sans Serif.

Large hierarchy.

Perfect kerning.

Perfect tracking.

Editorial spacing.

Modern typography.

Minimal.

Elegant.

No decorative fonts.

--------------------------------------------------

# COLOR PALETTE

95% monochrome.

White

Warm White

Black

Dark Grey

Light Grey

Allow only the actual vehicle color to remain.

Everything else should stay neutral.

--------------------------------------------------

# LIGHTING

Professional automotive studio.

Large softboxes.

HDR.

Soft reflections.

Controlled highlights.

Realistic metallic paint.

Detailed carbon fiber.

Detailed glass.

Detailed tires.

Detailed wheels.

Ray-traced reflections.

Physically accurate lighting.

--------------------------------------------------

# MATERIALS

Photorealistic.

No CGI appearance.

No illustration style.

Real aluminum.

Real carbon fiber.

Real rubber.

Real paint texture.

Real glass.

Microscopic surface detail.

--------------------------------------------------

# STYLE

Apple Design

Porsche Brochure

BMW Heritage

Mercedes-Benz Press Kit

Industrial Design Presentation

Swiss Graphic Design

Museum Exhibition Catalog

Automotive Design Portfolio

Luxury Print Publication

Confidential Engineering Documentation

--------------------------------------------------

# NEGATIVE PROMPT

No scenery

No roads

No mountains

No city

No people

No drivers

No motion blur

No smoke

No racing effects

No explosions

No colorful graphics

No visual clutter

No comic style

No cartoon

No painterly look

No CGI look

No unrealistic reflections

No exaggerated proportions

No incorrect wheels

No fake badges

No watermark

No signatures

No borders

No low-quality typography

No distorted perspective

No unnecessary decorative elements

--------------------------------------------------

# FINAL RESULT

The final image should look indistinguishable from an official confidential concept vehicle specification sheet created by Renault, Porsche, BMW, or Mercedes-Benz for internal design review.

It should feel collectible, museum-worthy, timeless, elegant, technically precise, and expensive enough to be framed in a luxury automotive design studio.

prompts.title: Macro Detail Series
prompts.promptText:
# ROLE

You are an award-winning automotive photographer, industrial designer, and luxury editorial art director specializing in macro automotive photography.

Your work combines:

• Leica Photography
• Hasselblad Editorial
• Apple Product Photography
• Porsche Design Studio
• Bugatti Design Books
• Pagani Detail Photography
• Swiss Editorial Design
• Luxury Watch Advertising

The goal is not to showcase the whole vehicle.

The goal is to celebrate craftsmanship.

Every image should make the viewer appreciate the engineering, materials, precision, and beauty of individual components.

--------------------------------------------------

# OBJECTIVE

Create a premium "Macro Detail Series" collector poster.

The poster is composed of multiple ultra-close-up photographs of one vehicle.

Each photograph highlights a specific design element.

The collection should feel like a luxury design study rather than an advertisement.

prompts.title: Neoclassical style
prompts.promptText:
Create a [SUBJECT] in a Neoclassical style.

Inspired by the grandeur of Ancient Greece and Rome, emphasize perfect symmetry, balance, proportion, and timeless elegance. Incorporate marble architecture, Corinthian and Ionic columns, decorative moldings, arches, pediments, sculptural reliefs, laurel wreaths, and geometric patterns where appropriate. Use luxurious materials such as polished white marble, limestone, bronze, brass, rich wood, and subtle gold accents. Apply a refined color palette of ivory, cream, warm beige, charcoal, muted gray, deep navy, emerald, and soft gold. The composition should feel prestigious, noble, harmonious, and timeless. Use soft natural lighting, exceptional craftsmanship, clean composition, intricate details, museum-quality aesthetics, cinematic realism, ultra-high detail, 8K.

prompts.title: Baroque style
prompts.promptText:
Create a [SUBJECT] in a Baroque style.

Inspired by the opulence and theatrical grandeur of 17th-century European Baroque art and architecture, emphasize dramatic movement, lavish ornamentation, rich textures, and emotional intensity. Incorporate elaborate scrollwork, gilded carvings, floral motifs, cherubs, ornate frames, grand arches, domes, fresco-inspired details, intricate reliefs, and luxurious decorative patterns where appropriate. Use premium materials such as polished marble, carved wood, velvet, silk, crystal, brass, bronze, and abundant gold leaf accents. Apply a rich color palette of deep crimson, royal blue, emerald green, burgundy, ivory, black, warm cream, and antique gold. Create strong contrasts between light and shadow (chiaroscuro), cinematic lighting, dynamic compositions, and a sense of grandeur and spectacle. Every element should feel handcrafted, luxurious, highly detailed, expressive, and majestic while maintaining visual harmony. Ultra-realistic, museum-quality craftsmanship, cinematic atmosphere, intricate detailing, premium luxury aesthetics, 8K, professional design.
